tools.name: bokadirekt_list_salons
tools.description: List the locations of your salon (the API calls them salons). Each has a salonId that bookings, staff, products and sales reference. Good first call. GET /api/v1/salons.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_companies
tools.description: List the legal entities (companies) that own products and issue receipts, with organisation number and whether product inventory is enabled. GET /api/v1/companies.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_services
tools.description: List the bookable services of the salon, with their ids and whether each is an add-on. GET /api/v1/services.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_resources
tools.description: List the bookable staff members (resources) with their location, online-booking flag, availability and price list. Takes an optional date range. GET /api/v1/resources.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_customers
tools.description: List the salon's customers with name, contact details, consent flags, city and birthday. The national ID is never returned. GET /api/v1/customers returns the full list in one response.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings in a date range: customer, staff, service, time, price, cancelled, no-show and online flags. Filter by scheduled start (0, default) or by creation time (1). At most 365 days per request. GET /api/v1/bookings.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_sales
tools.description: List sales receipts in a date range, with their rows and payments. At most 365 days per request. GET /api/v1/sales.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_products
tools.description: List the salon's retail products with supplier, barcode and stock per location. Read-only; stock is not changed here. GET /api/v1/products.
